title: No Advanced Chips for the CCP Act of 2025
last_action: Referred to the House Committee on Foreign Affairs.
summary: Would bar exports, reexports, or transfers of covered advanced AI semiconductors to China unless the Commerce Secretary approves them after an interagency national-security review and Congress separately enacts a joint resolution of approval. The authority would sunset after three years.
committee_dynamics: The proposal would replace ordinary executive-branch licensing discretion for covered China exports with an unusually strong congressional-approval requirement. It is substantively important even though it had not advanced beyond referral.
advance_rationale: The proposal is consequential but procedurally demanding and had no recorded committee action.
verification_level: Bill details and introduced text checked against official congressional sources.
